sentences.en: We all abide by law to live in any society.
sentences.zh: 我们在任何社会中都遵守法律生活。

sentences.en: That country is turning into a society with high education.
sentences.zh: 那个国家正在成为一个教育水平高的社会。

sentences.en: The old proverb still holds good in our modern society.
sentences.zh: 那句老话在我们现代社会中仍然适用。
